name: Chang Liang-neng
bio: Chang Liang-neng (章良能; Zhang Liangneng; d. 1214) was a writer of ci, the Chinese song lyrics composed to set tunes, in the Song dynasty.
The single ci here is from the chinese-poetry dataset of Zhu Zumou's 1924 anthology Three Hundred Song Lyrics (宋词三百首), in simplified characters, with the tune name as title.

poems.title: 小重山 (Xiao zhong shan)
poems.author: Chang Liang-neng
poems.collection: 宋詞三百首 (Three Hundred Song Lyrics)
poems.text:
柳暗花明春事深。
小阑红芍药，已抽簪。
雨馀风软碎鸣禽。
迟迟日，犹带一分阴。
往事莫沈吟。
身闲时序好，且登临。
旧游无处不堪寻。
无寻处，惟有少年心。
